tasks.title: Initialize shared package with Zod schemas and TypeScript configuration
tasks.description: Create packages/shared workspace with Zod schemas as single source of truth, TypeScript types, error codes, category codes (34 categories from L1 Table 12), i18n keys (fr/en), and design tokens including WCAG AA severity colours. Requirements: BF02-BF05, BNF07.
tasks.details:
1. Create packages/shared/package.json with name '@secure360/shared', exports field for ESM/CJS.
2. Create tsconfig.json extending tsconfig.base.json with composite:true, outDir:dist.
3. Create src/schemas/ with Zod schemas using .strict():
   - auth.schema.ts: LoginInput, VerifyTotpInput, RefreshInput, ResetPasswordInput
   - incident.schema.ts: CreateIncidentInput, UpdateIncidentInput, IncidentFilters
   - user.schema.ts: CreateUserInput, UpdateUserInput
   - organization.schema.ts: CreateOrgInput
   - message.schema.ts: CreateMessageInput
4. Create src/types/ inferring types from Zod schemas: export type LoginInput = z.infer<typeof LoginInputSchema>
5. Create src/constants/error-codes.ts: AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS, AUTH_2FA_REQUIRED, TENANT_FORBIDDEN, etc. per L2 Table 7.
6. Create src/constants/categories.ts: 9 groups, 34 categories with fr/en labels, default severities (L1 Table 12 + SIM swap MOB-02).
7. Create src/i18n/: fr.json and en.json with all UI strings, shared between mobile and web.
8. Create src/tokens/: colors.ts (#8F5600 for Moderate text, #B34700 for High text), spacing.ts, typography.ts.
9. Create src/index.ts barrel export.
10. Update root tsconfig.json references array to include packages/shared.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests with Vitest: validate Zod schemas accept valid input, reject invalid input; verify all 34 categories exist with both fr and en labels; verify design token values match specification; verify TypeScript compilation produces correct .d.ts files.

subtasks.title: Create packages/shared workspace with package.json and TypeScript configuration
subtasks.description: Set up the packages/shared directory structure with proper package.json exports configuration for ESM/CJS and tsconfig.json extending the base configuration with composite mode.
subtasks.details:
1. Create packages/shared directory structure.
2. Create packages/shared/package.json with:
   - name: '@secure360/shared'
   - version: '0.0.0'
   - type: 'module'
   - exports field for ESM/CJS dual package support (./dist/index.js for import, ./dist/index.cjs for require)
   - main: './dist/index.cjs'
   - module: './dist/index.js'
   - types: './dist/index.d.ts'
   - files: ['dist']
   - scripts: { 'build': 'tsc', 'typecheck': 'tsc --noEmit' }
   - dependencies: { 'zod': '^3.23.0' }
3. Create packages/shared/tsconfig.json extending '../tsconfig.base.json' with:
   - composite: true
   - outDir: './dist'
   - rootDir: './src'
   - declarationMap: true
4. Create packages/shared/src/index.ts as empty barrel export file.
5. Update root tsconfig.json references array to include { "path": "./packages/shared" }.
6. Run 'npm install' to link workspace and install zod dependency.
7. Verify TypeScript compilation with 'npm run typecheck -w @secure360/shared'.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify npm workspace resolves @secure360/shared; verify tsc compiles without errors; verify .d.ts files generated in dist/; verify exports field allows both import and require syntax.

tasks.title: Configure Docker Compose for PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 8 development environment
tasks.description: Create Docker Compose configuration for local development with PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 8, including volume persistence and health checks. Requirements: Technical Architecture, Phase S5.
tasks.details:
1. Create infra/docker-compose.dev.yml:
   ```yaml
   services:
     postgres:
       image: postgres:16-alpine
       environment:
         POSTGRES_DB: secure360
         POSTGRES_USER: secure360
         POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_password
       volumes:
         - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
         - ./init-db:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
       ports: ['5432:5432']
       healthcheck:
         test: pg_isready -U secure360
         interval: 5s
     redis:
       image: redis:8-alpine
       command: redis-server --appendonly yes
       volumes:
         - redisdata:/data
       ports: ['6379:6379']
       healthcheck:
         test: redis-cli ping
   volumes:
     pgdata:
     redisdata:
   secrets:
     db_password:
       file: ./secrets/db_password.txt
   ```
2. Create infra/secrets/db_password.txt with placeholder (git-ignored).
3. Create infra/init-db/01-roles.sql for creating database roles (s360_owner, s360_app, s360_worker, s360_metrics).
4. Add npm script 'docker:dev': 'docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d'.
5. Create .env.example with DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL templates.
tasks.testStrategy: Run docker:dev and verify both containers start with healthy status; verify PostgreSQL accepts connections on localhost:5432; verify Redis accepts connections on localhost:6379; verify database roles are created.

tasks.title: Implement Prisma schema with complete L2 data model and RLS policies

tasks.details:
1. Install prisma, @prisma/client in apps/api.
2. Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma with all models:
   - Organization: id (uuid), name, slug, is_active, created_at, updated_at
   - User: id, organization_id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, role (enum), totp_secret (encrypted), totp_enabled, session_version, must_change_password, is_active, created_at
   - Incident: id, organization_id, reporter_id, reference (SFC-YYYY-NNNNNN), category_code, severity (Low/Moderate/High/Critical), title, description, is_anonymous, status (NEW/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS/RESOLVED/CLOSED), assigned_to_id, version, resolved_at, closed_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at
   - IncidentCategory: code (PK), group_code, label_fr, label_en, default_severity, sort_order
   - IncidentStatusHistory: id, incident_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by_id, comment, created_at
   - IncidentMessage: id, incident_id, sender_id, body, is_internal, created_at
   - Attachment: id, incident_id, message_id, file_key, encryption_iv, original_name, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at
   - Notification: id, user_id, incident_id, type, title_key, body_key, read_at, created_at
   - AuditLog: id, organization_id, user_id, event, entity_type, entity_id, old_data, new_data, ip_address, user_agent, created_at
   - RefreshToken: id, user_id, token_hash, family_id, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at
   - PasswordResetToken: id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at
   - DeviceToken: id, user_id, token, platform, created_at
   - OutboxEvent: id, event_type, payload, processed_at, created_at
   - IdempotencyKey: key (PK), user_id, response, expires_at, created_at
   - ReportJob: id, organization_id, requested_by_id, type, parameters, status, file_key, error, created_at, completed_at
   - IncidentReferenceCounter: organization_id (PK), year, counter
3. Create migration with RLS policies in raw SQL:
   - Enable RLS: ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE users FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
   - Policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users USING (organization_id::text = current_setting('app.org_id', true));
   - Grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON users TO s360_app; REVOKE ALL ON users FROM PUBLIC;
tasks.testStrategy: Run prisma migrate dev and verify migration applies cleanly; verify RLS policies exist with \dp in psql; write integration test that sets app.org_id and verifies queries only return matching tenant data; test that queries without app.org_id fail.

tasks.title: Implement error handler and API response envelope
tasks.description: Create centralized error handling middleware and response envelope utilities ensuring consistent API responses. Requirements: Technical Architecture, L2 Table 7.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/lib/errors.ts with custom error classes:
   - AppError: base class with code, message, statusCode, details?
   - ValidationError: extends AppError, 400
   - AuthenticationError: extends AppError, 401
   - AuthorizationError: extends AppError, 403
   - NotFoundError: extends AppError, 404
   - ConflictError: extends AppError, 409
   - RateLimitError: extends AppError, 429
   - InternalError: extends AppError, 500
2. Create src/lib/response.ts with envelope utilities:
   - success<T>(data: T, message?: string): { success: true, data, message? }
   - error(code: string, message: string, details?: unknown): { success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }

4. Use error codes from @secure360/shared/constants/error-codes.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test each error class produces correct status code; unit test envelope functions produce correct shape; integration test that thrown ValidationError returns 400 with proper envelope; test Prisma unique violation maps to ConflictError.

tasks.title: Implement Redis client and rate limiting middleware
tasks.description: Set up Redis client with reconnection handling and implement token bucket rate limiting per L2 Table 5 limits. Requirements: Phase S5, L2 Table 5.
tasks.details:
1. Install ioredis in apps/api.
2. Create src/lib/redis.ts:

   - Export client singleton and typed commands
   - Create pub/sub client for real-time events
3. Create src/middleware/rate-limiter.middleware.ts:
   - Implement sliding window rate limiter using Redis
   - Key pattern: rate:{endpoint}:{identifier} (IP or userId)
   - Limits from L2 Table 5:
     * POST /auth/login: 5/minute per IP
     * POST /auth/verify-2fa: 5/minute per IP

   - Factory function: rateLimiter({ points: number, duration: number, keyPrefix: string })

5. Add bypass for health check endpoints.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test rate limiter correctly tracks requests in Redis; integration test that 6th login attempt within minute returns 429; test Retry-After header is set correctly; test rate limit resets after window expires.

tasks.title: Implement auth module: login and 2FA verification endpoints
tasks.description: Create authentication endpoints for email/password login and TOTP 2FA verification with replay protection. Requirements: BF01, Phase S5.
tasks.details:

2. Create src/modules/auth/auth.repository.ts:
   - findUserByEmail(email: string)

tasks.title: Implement logout, password reset, and first-login password change
tasks.description: Create endpoints for logout (revoke current token), forgot/reset password flow with secure tokens, and forced password change at first login. Requirements: BF01, Phase S5.
tasks.details:
1. Add to auth.repository.ts:
   - createPasswordResetToken(userId, tokenHash, expiresAt)
   - findPasswordResetToken(tokenHash)
   - markResetTokenUsed(id)
   - updateUserPassword(userId, passwordHash)
   - clearMustChangePassword(userId)
2. Add to auth.service.ts:
   - logout(refreshToken): revoke token and optionally entire family
   - forgotPassword(email): create token (1h expiry), queue email, return nothing (prevent enumeration)
   - resetPassword(token, newPassword): verify token, update password, increment session_version
   - changePassword(userId, currentPassword, newPassword): verify current, update, clear must_change_password
3. Create endpoints:
   - POST /auth/logout (authenticated)
   - POST /auth/forgot-password (public, rate limited 3/min)
   - POST /auth/reset-password (public)
   - POST /auth/change-password (authenticated)
4. Reset token: 32 bytes random, stored as SHA-256 hash, 1 hour expiry.
5. Session version increment invalidates all existing JWTs.
6. Audit: auth.logout, auth.password.reset_requested, auth.password.reset, auth.password.changed.

2. Create src/modules/incidents/incidents.state-machine.ts:
   ```typescript
   const TRANSITIONS: Record<Status, Status[]> = {
     NEW: ['ASSIGNED'],
     ASSIGNED: ['IN_PROGRESS', 'NEW'],
     IN_PROGRESS: ['RESOLVED', 'ASSIGNED'],
     RESOLVED: ['CLOSED', 'IN_PROGRESS'],  // can reopen
     CLOSED: ['IN_PROGRESS'],               // can reopen
   };
   
   export const canTransition = (from: Status, to: Status): boolean => 
     TRANSITIONS[from]?.includes(to) ?? false;
   ```

tasks.title: Create backup and restore procedure with verification
tasks.description: Implement automated backup job with off-host storage and verified restore procedure. Requirements: O4, Phase S12.
tasks.details:
1. Create infra/backup/scripts/backup.sh:
   ```bash
   #!/bin/bash
   set -euo pipefail
   
   TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
   BACKUP_FILE="secure360_${TIMESTAMP}.sql.gz"
   
   # Dump database
   pg_dump -h postgres -U secure360 secure360 | gzip > /backups/${BACKUP_FILE}
   
   # Upload to off-host storage (within Cameroon)
   rclone copy /backups/${BACKUP_FILE} remote:secure360-backups/
   
   # Cleanup old backups (keep 30 days)
   find /backups -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime +30 -delete
   rclone delete remote:secure360-backups/ --min-age 30d
   
   # Verify backup integrity
   gunzip -t /backups/${BACKUP_FILE}
   
   echo "Backup completed: ${BACKUP_FILE}"
   ```
2. Create infra/backup/scripts/restore.sh:
   ```bash
   #!/bin/bash
   BACKUP_FILE=$1
   
   # Stop API and worker
   docker compose stop api worker
   
   # Restore database
   gunzip -c ${BACKUP_FILE} | psql -h postgres -U secure360 secure360
   
   # Restart services
   docker compose start api worker
   ```
3. Configure backup schedule: daily at 2 AM.
4. Configure off-host target within Cameroon (Law 2024/017).
5. Test restore procedure:
   - Create backup
   - Modify data
   - Restore backup
   - Verify data restored correctly
6. Document RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
tasks.testStrategy: Test backup script creates valid compressed dump; test restore script recovers data correctly; test off-host upload succeeds; test old backup cleanup works; document RTO < 1 hour, RPO < 24 hours.
